name: Open WebUI
tagline: Open WebUI (formerly Ollama WebUI) is an open-source, self-hosted web interface that brings a polished ChatGPT-like experience to local AI models running via Ollama, LM Studio, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. It supports multiple users, conversation history, document uploads, web search integration, image generation, and a growing plugin ecosystem. IT teams and AI enthusiasts deploy it on their own servers to give their organisation a private, self-hosted AI assistant with no data leaving their infrastructure.
